children: Bitcoin may be entering a new bull market, according to Fidelity global macro director Jurrien Timmer, whose view was cited by Bitcoin Magazine. According to ChainCatcher, Timmer said a new four-year-cycle bull market may already have begun based on power-law patterns. He added that there is no clear narrative yet, but bull markets rarely start with one.

title: Fidelity's Jurrien Timmer Says Bitcoin May Be Entering a New Bull Market
